Flood: Move to higher ground immediately if water levels are rising.
Do not walk or drive through moving flood water.
Turn off electricity if it is safe to do so.
Keep emergency supplies and important documents ready.
Follow evacuation instructions from local authorities.
Fire: Leave the building immediately using the nearest safe exit.
Do not use elevators during a fire.
Stay low if there is smoke.
Call emergency services from a safe location.
Do not re-enter the building until authorities declare it safe.
Earthquake: Drop to the ground, take cover, and hold on.
Stay away from windows and heavy objects.
After shaking stops, move carefully to an open area.
Cyclone: Stay indoors and away from windows.
Keep emergency food, water, and medical supplies ready.
Move to an official shelter if instructed.
Landslide: Move away from slopes and unstable areas immediately.
Listen for unusual sounds such as cracking trees or moving rocks.
Avoid river valleys during heavy rainfall.
Do not return to affected areas until declared safe.
